Definition: from G1417 and G1176; two and ten, i.e. a dozen:--twelve.
BiblicalUsage: Twelve, the number of the tribes and the apostles, and the number that keeps turning up when God gathers His people. The risen Christ was seen by the twelve, the apostles called the twelve together to appoint servants, and the baskets left over from the feeding were twelve. James writes to the twelve tribes scattered abroad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe twelve is God's number for a complete people, and the fragments gathered up after the feeding are the picture of it. Nothing He gives is wasted, and no one He calls is left out of the count.
